items.source: model - a Map of model names (Strings) to model objects (Objects). Model entries may not be null, but the model Map may be null if there is no model data.
items.translation: `model` - 一个将模型名称（String）映射到模型对象（Object）的 Map。模型条目不能为 `null`，但如果不存在模型数据，则 model Map 可以为 `null`。

items.source: Convenient constructor when there is no model data to expose. Can also be used in conjunction with addObject.

items.source: status - an HTTP status code to use for the response (to be set just prior to View rendering)

items.translation: 可用于在 HandlerInterceptor 的postHandle方法中抑制给定 ModelAndView 对象的渲染。

items.source:
Represents a model and view returned by a handler, to be resolved
by a DispatcherServlet. The view can take the form of a String
view name which will need to be resolved by a ViewResolver object;
alternatively a View object can be specified directly. The model
is a Map, allowing the use of multiple objects keyed by name.
items.translation: 表示由处理器返回并由 DispatcherServlet 解析的模型和视图。视图可以是一个需要由 ViewResolver 对象解析的 String 视图名称；或者可以直接指定一个 View 对象。模型是一个 Map，允许使用多个以名称为键的对象。

items.source: The response status is set just prior to View rendering.
items.translation: 响应状态在视图渲染之前设置。

items.source: Return the underlying ModelMap instance (never null).
items.translation: 返回底层的ModelMap实例（永远不会为null）。

items.translation: 返回 View 对象，或者如果我们使用视图名称并通过 ViewResolver 由 DispatcherServlet 解析时，返回null。

items.source: Return the view name to be resolved by the DispatcherServlet via a ViewResolver, or null if we are using a View object.
items.translation: 返回由 DispatcherServlet 通过 ViewResolver 解析的视图名称，或者如果我们使用的是 View 对象则为 `null`。

items.source: Create a new ModelAndView given a View object and a model. Note: the supplied model data is copied into the internal storage of this class. You should not consider to modify the supplied Map after supplying it to this class
items.translation: 根据 View 对象和模型创建一个新的 ModelAndView。 注意：提供的模型数据已复制到本类的内部存储中。在将此类提供该 Map 后，您不应考虑对其进行修改。

items.source: Return whether we use a view reference, i.e. true if the view has been specified via a name to be resolved by the DispatcherServlet via a ViewResolver.
items.translation: 返回是否使用了视图引用，即如果视图已通过名称指定，并由 `DispatcherServlet` 通过 `ViewResolver` 解析，则返回 `true`。

items.source: Return the model map. May return null. Called by DispatcherServlet for evaluation of the model.
items.translation: 返回模型映射。可能返回null。由 DispatcherServlet 调用以评估模型。

items.source: Return the model map. Never returns null. To be called by application code for modifying the model.
items.translation: 返回模型映射。永远不会返回null。由应用程序代码调用以修改模型。
